messages.content: What is the freezing point point of water at a pressure of 10 kPa?

function.name: thermodynamics_calculate_boiling_point
function.description: Calculate the boiling point of a given substance at a specific pressure. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

message.content:
At a pressure of **10 kPa** (≈ 0.1 atm) water freezes at a temperature slightly below 0 °C.  
Using the water‑phase diagram (or the Clausius–Clapeyron relation for the solid–liquid boundary) gives:

\[
T_{\text{freeze}}(10\ \text{kPa}) \;\approx\; -2.2^{\circ}\text{C}
\]

So, under a pressure of 10 kPa, water will begin to freeze at roughly **–2.2 °C**.
